integrity: Analytical derivation of a positive universal tail coefficient and exact moment threshold; deterministic and seeded finite diagnostics supplied separately, not substituted for a proof. Publication priority and independent validation not certified.
scientific_limitations: Stationary centered full-rank Gaussian OU diffusion, fixed positive lag and \(d\ge2\) only. The unbounded chord-speed ratio is not a bounded principal angle. Small-lag divergence remains; no motor performance or nonlinear extension follows.
title: Dimensional cutoff for sampled angular-speed fluctuations in Gaussian diffusions
